_comment: The word classes BlasterAI knows — the app loads this file (VocabularyClasses), so it is the source of truth. 'caregiverSelectable' classes are the ones a new word may use, in a spreadsheet cell ('cat, animal') or in the app. 'partOfSpeech' is the fallback that colors a new word when nothing better is known; null means no word color.

classes.name: food
classes.note: Absorbs the former meals/fruit/veggie/snacks buckets (2026-08). The class string goes into the sentence prompt, and those sub-splits told the model nothing the word did not.

classes.name: nature
classes.note: The outdoors that is neither growing nor weather: rock, mud, puddle, hill, sky, moon.

classes.name: time
classes.note: Days, months, seasons, parts of the day, clock and when-words. 'fall (time)' reads as autumn where 'fall (object)' read as a dropped thing.

classes.name: object
classes.note: Last resort: concrete objects, tools and vehicles no more specific class fits.

classes.name: letter
classes.note: Drawn, not generated (GlyphTile). Not a word, so no part of speech.

classes.name: number
classes.note: Drawn, not generated. A determiner: 'three cookies' quantifies.

classes.name: unspecified
classes.note: A word added without a class: in the editor, from a spreadsheet, in bulk. Nobody has to stop and choose, as in Avaz, whose new words are type None. Not a meaning: prompts never see it, the AI never picks it, and the tile draws plain so the edit surfaces can keep asking for a real class, which is what gives a word its color.

classes.name: core
classes.note: Structural. Mixed prepositions, pronouns and determiners; every bundled one is in the part-of-speech table, so this fallback is nearly unreachable.

classes.name: page_link
classes.note: Structural: page and scene covers, minted by the app.
